title: AngularLynx component schematic
description: Generates a standalone Angular component with Lynx element template.

name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the component?

path.description: The path at which to create the component, relative to the source root.

prefix.description: The selector prefix to use. Defaults to the project prefix from angular.json.

inlineStyle.description: Include styles inline in the component.ts file.

inlineTemplate.description: Include template inline in the component.ts file.

skipTests.description: Do not generate a spec file.

flat.description: Create the component files at the top level of the path, without a subdirectory.
